subject: MAP: security gates, DPA redlines and evaluation close timeline
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@finova.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@finova.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: MAP kickoff — security gates, DPA redlines and target close

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is comfortable with core performance and we'd like to lock the mutual action plan (MAP) so we can hit our procurement window. Target: contract signed by 2027-07-15. Critical security gates we need addressed inside the MAP:

- SOC 2: need last report + date of last exam and scope (in-scope services and exclusions).
- SIG/CAIQ: we need your CAIQ responses or confirmation you will accept our completed SIG questionnaire by 2027-06-28.
- DPA: our legal team will send DPA redlines; can you review within 5 business days of receipt?
- Data retention & residency: requirement is EU data for EU customers and retention windows by data class (we will share the retention matrix).

Can you confirm these items and attach an initial MAP worksheet we can align on? Also confirm who on your side will be primary for evidence intake and SOC2 questions.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Li
Head of Security Programs, Finova
Attachments: none (will share SIG via separate upload)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@finova.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gates, DPA redlines and target close

Hannah —

Appreciate the clear target. Attached is a working MAP worksheet (redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) that maps out milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria for the security/compliance items you listed. Quick confirmations inline: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II in 2026-11; scope includes hosted API and the platform control plane — excludes customer-managed private deployments (we'll call this out in the MAP). I attached a pointer to the report request process in the sheet.
- SIG/CAIQ: we can provide a completed CAIQ export. If you prefer to run your SIG, we will take the questionnaire and return responses within 3 business days after receipt.
- DPA: please send redlines to legal@redwood.com; we aim to turnaround DISCUSSION first pass within 3 business days and signable version within 10 business days, barring substantive carveouts.
- Data retention & residency: we support EU residency for private deployments and hosted-region controls; retention windows are configurable per customer. Need your retention matrix to map to our storage classes.

Owners on our side:
- SOC2 & evidence intake: Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.com)
- DPA & contract questions: Legal (legal@redwood.com) / me for escalation
- Data residency & retention mapping: Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwood.com)

Next steps I propose:
1) You upload SIG/CAIQ by 2027-06-24.
2) We complete CAIQ responses or return answers to your SIG by 2027-06-28.
3) You send DPA redlines (if any) by 2027-06-25 so Legal can begin review.
4) We sync on retention matrix by 2027-06-26.

If that cadence works, I'll update the MAP milestones and owners and push a version back to you.

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Dir., Solutions & GTM, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Adding a couple of clarifying points on SOC 2 scope and retention mapping so we have them in the MAP: 

- SOC 2 scope detail: I'll attach the evidence list in the MAP worksheet under the SOC2 tab. For clarity: infrastructure (hosting layer) and control plane are in-scope; customer data access controls depend on deployment mode (hosted API vs dedicated/private).
- Retention & residency: if Finova requires EU residency for EU customers, we propose a split: EU region for processing + long-term archival in EU object store. Default retention classes we support: ephemeral (30 days), standard (1 year), long-term archive (7 years). If you need shorter/longer windows for specific data classes, we can map those in the retention matrix and show expected impact on cost and SLA.

I'll own SOC2 evidence intake and will coordinate with Hannah on required artifacts. Neha will start the residency mapping once we receive your retention matrix.

Kimberly Park
Manager, Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

Thanks — quick update and uploads.

1) SIG/CAIQ: uploaded our completed SIG to the shared workspace and attached a copy (Finova_SIG_CAIQ.xlsx) — please confirm receipt. We expect completed responses by EOD 2027-06-28.
2) DPA redlines: legal sent a redline (DPA_Finova_redline_v2.docx) to legal@redwood.com earlier today; DocuSign link for execution will follow once comments are reconciled: https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-link/ABC123
3) SOC2: attaching the SOC2 cert we have on file for reference (Finova_SOC2_cert.pdf) — this is Finova's internal cert, not Redwood's, included for context on required controls.

Action items we need from Redwood by 2027-06-28:
- Completed CAIQ / or clear timeline for completion.
- DPA comment turnaround within 5 business days.
- Retention matrix mapping for our three data classes (PII, telemetry, logs).

If those align, we will update the MAP with estimated procurement dates and push the contract to Legal for signature window starting 2027-07-05.

Hannah

---
Final internal note (not sent to Finova):
- Kimberly to pull SOC2 artifact inventory and start evidence intake.
- Neha to map retention classes to our archive tiers and estimate cost delta.
- Legal to acknowledge redline and confirm turnaround SLA.

I'll update the MAP and push version 2 to Hannah by EOD 2027-06-24.
